Modular Prefab Houses

Our modular prefab houses combine industrialized manufacturing with flexible design. Standardized modules are produced in the factory and assembled on site, cutting construction time, on-site labor and waste versus traditional building. The family covers space capsule houses, integrated panel houses, waterfront cabins, star-view glamping domes and design cabins for residential, resort and commercial projects.

Key Features

Why Buyers Choose This Range

  • Industrialized factory production
  • Fast modular assembly
  • Energy-efficient insulated envelopes
  • A-class fire-rated options
  • 50+ year design life (capsule series)
  • Resort / residential / commercial
